fields.doc: Share of the machine's memory one model may take (ADR 0033), 0.2–1.0. The browser ignores it: a tab gets all it can address (4 GB).
While the view moves, keep at least this frame rate by leaving out what is smallest on screen, and draw everything again once it stops (0: never leave anything out).
On a machine that misses that frame rate, draw far parts as simplified stand-ins while the view moves (ADR 0036 #9).
Test each shared shape's copies against the view on the GPU (ADR 0036 #10; where compute shaders exist). Experimental: no gain measured yet.
Body text size of the interface, points.
Who you are (#52, until there is a server to sign in to): the author of commits, the owner of borrowed elements ("this element belongs to …").
Files opened last, newest first (the desktop; Home, #52).
The system coordinates are read in (ADR 0045): "survey" (the model's own: LV95 for Swiss models), "wgs84", "utm" (ETRS89, the point's zone) or "epsg:N" (LV03, a State Plane zone…).
